note: Susquehanna County (PA) does not zone; Pennsylvania counties cannot zone and the county's planning office covers only subdivision review. The county's boroughs and townships zone their own land. The largest borough, Montrose, publishes its zoning ordinance and zoning map only as PDF (montroseborough.com permits page). Forest City and Hallstead have no zoning service found. ArcGIS Online and Hub searches for zoning in the county returned no district layer. The county GIS page links only parcel and reference web maps, no zoning layer.
